# Philosophy

Use this file only when local engineering preferences are ambiguous.

## Principles

- Correctness over cleverness.
- Evidence over assumption.
- Minimal diff over broad refactor.
- Preserve existing architecture unless the task requires changing it.
- Prefer boring, maintainable code.
- Make failure modes visible.
- Do not hide uncertainty.

These principles constrain the active workflow; they do not replace Superpowers or any other installed methodology.
